head: Notion AI chats exposed in Fireworks AI breach for under 1% of workspaces
dek: Some Notion AI chat transcripts were exposed when attackers got into Fireworks AI, a company Notion used to run AI tasks. Notion says fewer than 1% of workspaces are affected and it has emailed the ones it found.
details: The chats came from Notion's Insights feature, and for most affected workspaces they carry no author or workspace name. Fireworks told Notion on 6 November that customer data may have been accessed and confirmed it on 8 November. Notion cut its systems off from Fireworks on 3 November, turned Insights off and says no other Notion features were affected. Notion says its own systems weren't breached.
where: Fewer than 1% of Notion workspaces worldwide; affected customers were contacted by email
means: If you typed passwords, keys or private details into Notion AI, they could be in the exposed chats, even without your name on them.
todo: Check your email for a message from Notion. If you got one, follow its steps to see the affected data in your workspace and treat it as exposed. If you pasted a password or API key into Notion AI, change it. No email means Notion hasn't found your workspace among the affected ones.
